text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"The time looks great. I feel like my legs 
were moving really well, too!"
choice_data_list: You look like you're in great shape!
You look like you're in great shape!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Indeed indeed! It's all thanks to 
Trainer~♪
choice_data_list: No, this is the fruit of your efforts.
No, it's the result of your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Well, I'm the one running, of course. 
But you're always—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Man, I hate this. Why does my engine only 
start warming up right at the very end...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no no, it's already so late, I'd feel 
bad.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...You're the one who said it, Trainer, 
okay? Don't regret it later!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Trainer. Are you really okay with 
training this early?
choice_data_list:
You have your part-time job in the 
evening, right?
You've got work in the evening, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: Then let's get a run in right now!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Like that, you know? You've always stayed 
right by my side at my own pace, haven't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So, I guess it's also thanks to that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really grateful, you know? After all, 
you're always looking out for me."
choice_data_list:
Then let's call it a joint effort between 
the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, you're always so quick to be 
humble~. ...Well, but still—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Belonging to both of you" means my joy 
belongs to the two of you as well, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Hehe, doing it that way 
sounds nice too.
